name: Pinpoint
description: Collaborative website feedback tool — annotate live websites with your team.
_host_permissions_comment: Development defaults only. The production build pipeline replaces host_permissions (and content_scripts.matches) with the deployment allow-list configured per Requirement 32.3.
_optional_host_permissions_comment: Requested at runtime, never at install time. `https://*/*` + `http://*/*` back the on-demand content-script injection on any site the user chooses (granted temporarily per-tab via activeTab on action click; a durable grant is requested from the options page via chrome.permissions.request for the user's configured Server URL).
_web_accessible_resources_comment: The content entry dynamically imports its chunks at runtime; on-demand injection runs it on arbitrary origins, so the chunks must be fetchable from any site. This exposes only the extension's own JS/assets (standard for CRXJS). CRXJS appends its own hashed content/asset entries (scoped to the static localhost matches) at build time; this entry widens the SAME chunks to every origin so the on-demand loader's dynamic import resolves on non-localhost hosts. `use_dynamic_url` is left false to match CRXJS's own chunk entry — CRXJS emits a fixed `chrome.runtime.getURL(...)` in the loader, and a per-session rotating URL would not line up with it.
